evals.name: greenfield-cli
evals.prompt: I want to scaffold a new Python CLI project called 'kvstore' that will be a small kv-store inspector for local JSON config files. I'm starting from an empty directory. Use the gan-harness substrate at /Users/eason/person_project/gan-harness/ as the source. Walk me through setup.
evals.expected_output: Target directory has .claude/ tree (without setup-gan-harness-skills/), CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md with ### Domain docs block, README.md from template referencing /init, specs/_epic/.gitkeep, specs/epics/.gitkeep. Stack skill for python (or python-stdlib) wired into .claude/agents/{planner,generator,evaluator}.md frontmatter skills: lists.

evals.name: brownfield-fastapi
evals.prompt: I have an existing FastAPI app at this path. I want to add gan-harness so I can use /init /loop /finalize to develop new features. The app is python-fastapi stack with pytest. Use /Users/eason/person_project/gan-harness/ as source.
evals.expected_output: Target directory gains .claude/ tree, CLAUDE.md ### Domain docs block injected (existing CLAUDE.md preserved otherwise), python-fastapi stack skill copied or scaffolded, agent frontmatter wired. specs/_epic/.gitkeep + specs/epics/.gitkeep created. Existing app source untouched.

evals.name: v1-to-v3.8-migration
evals.prompt: I have an existing project that was set up with v1 gan-harness (has specs/_batch/ and references to /prd, /plan in CLAUDE.md). I want to migrate it to v3.8. The current epic in _batch is fully archived already. Walk me through the migration.
evals.expected_output: specs/_batch/ renamed to specs/_epic/. specs/completed/ renamed to specs/epics/. CLAUDE.md ### Domain docs block updated (or v1 references removed if they exist outside the block). v1 commands (.claude/commands/{prd,plan,execution-loop}.md) deleted; v3.8 commands (init.md, loop.md, finalize.md) present. Old skills (prd-workflow, plan-workflow, escalation) removed; new skills (init-workflow, planner-handbook, etc.) present.
